text:
Owner decision briefs, part 2 of 3: have the audience role rate each decision brief against docs/conventions/owner-style.md, and rewrite a brief rated 3 or lower once before it is published; record each rating.
Depends on 20261103-075205-wbtm
- Reuse the existing audience role and its rating record; the brief text is its input instead of the live page.
- A test with a fake audience reply rating a brief 2 shows one rewrite and a recorded rating; a rating of 4 publishes without a rewrite.
- CHANGELOG.md gets an entry.
- Do not list a repository-wide fmt, clippy or test run as its own acceptance criterion.
Priority: normal
